evals.prompt: I sneak past Guard Karl and pick the cell lock to free Valen
evals.expected_output: Executes python dnd.py play command, processes the multi-agent execution trace, updates party/world state, and returns rich DM narration.
expectations: Uses python dnd.py play with player intent
Does not fabricate dice rolls or math manually
Presents atmospheric DM narration and execution steps

evals.prompt: What is our current party health and where are we right now?
evals.expected_output: Executes python dnd.py status to query campaign state and displays active party stats, location, and quests.
expectations: Displays Aria and Eldrin stats and current location

evals.prompt: I attack Guard Karl with my dagger to silence him
evals.expected_output: Executes attack via dnd.py, resolves attack vs AC, applies damage deterministically, and reflects NPC HP reduction.
expectations: Executes deterministic attack via dnd.py play or dnd.py attack
Updates Guard Karl HP in state
